model.catLabel: Dean AG30 spec page (no public parts book)
model.note: Part outlines are traced from Dean's photo of its current AG30 3 t hydraulic tipper (formerly the Mark II farm tipper) and are approximate; the club's 2008, 2013 and 2022 trailers may differ in sides, rail, hitch, hydraulics and brakes. The tipping ram, wheel bearings, brakes and lights are hidden or not shown and are listed. No Dean manual or parts book was obtained, so the checks are best practice: read each trailer's compliance plate.

side.name: Drop side (left) and tray body
side.desc: Drop side on the Dean tipper in the photo (check the club trailers). Tipper: bed down and latched before towing; load secured and within the trailer ATM and the tow vehicle's rating. Never work under a raised bed without the safety prop. Grease any pivots every 3 months.

rack.name: Front panel and headboard rail
rack.desc: Front panel with the headboard rail above it, as on the Dean in the photo. Tipper: bed down and latched before towing; load secured and within the trailer ATM and the tow vehicle's rating. Never work under a raised bed without the safety prop. Grease any pivots every 3 months.

tailgate.name: Tailgate
tailgate.desc: Rear tailgate (seen edge-on in the photo). Tipper: bed down and latched before towing; load secured and within the trailer ATM and the tow vehicle's rating. Never work under a raised bed without the safety prop. Grease any pivots every 3 months.

stake.name: Side stake
stake.desc: Side post for the drop side. Tipper: bed down and latched before towing; load secured and within the trailer ATM and the tow vehicle's rating. Never work under a raised bed without the safety prop. Grease any pivots every 3 months.

chassis.name: Chassis, axle mounts and side rail
chassis.desc: Annual: check the chassis, drawbar, coupling and safety-chain attachment for cracks, corrosion and wear, and the suspension springs, shackles and bushes if fitted.

drawbar.name: Drawbar
drawbar.desc: Annual: check for cracks, corrosion and wear, including the safety-chain attachment points. Before each tow: safety chain(s) connected with rated shackles.

hose.name: Tipping hose
hose.desc: Before each tow: tipping-ram hose undamaged, no oil leaks. Every 3 months: hoses and fittings, ram seals. Rams and hoses leak if the bed is stored raised or the hoses rub: store the bed down and route the hose clear.

coupling.name: Hitch plate, coupling and safety chains
coupling.desc: Before each tow: coupling locked and pinned; safety chain(s) connected with rated shackles; jockey wheel or stand up. Grease the coupling every 3 months. Annual: check the coupling and safety-chain attachment for wear and cracks.

jack.name: Jack stand
jack.desc: Raise and stow it before towing. Grease it every 3 months.

wheelL.name: Wheel and tyre, left
wheelL.desc: Before each tow: tyre pressure, cuts and tread, and wheel nuts tight. Every 3 months: re-torque the wheel nuts and check tyre condition and the spare. Tyre size and pressure: read the Dean compliance plate (not obtained). Wheel bearings: see the hidden 'wheel bearings' entry.

wheelR.name: Wheel and tyre, right
wheelR.desc: Before each tow: tyre pressure, cuts and tread, and wheel nuts tight. Every 3 months: re-torque the wheel nuts and check tyre condition and the spare. Tyre size and pressure: read the Dean compliance plate (not obtained). Wheel bearings: see the hidden 'wheel bearings' entry.

ram.name: Tipping ram, power pack and pivots
ram.desc: Hydraulic tipping from a power pack and battery, or from the tow vehicle's hydraulics: check which on each trailer. Power pack oil spec and capacity per Dean (not obtained). Every 3 months: power pack oil level, hoses and fittings, ram seals, pump battery charge and terminals; grease the tipping pivots and ram pins. Annual: change the hydraulic oil if contaminated; inspect the ram and hoses. Never work under a raised bed without the safety prop.

bearings.name: Wheel bearings and seals
bearings.desc: Annual: check for play and noise; repack or replace and fit new seals yearly or at the maker's km interval. Trailers that sit wet on the course get water in the bearings: check them yearly even at low km. Bearing kits go by axle/hub make: read the hub stamping on each trailer.

brakes.name: Brakes and breakaway (if fitted)
brakes.desc: If the trailer has brakes: every 3 months check adjustment and operation and test the breakaway system; yearly inspect the shoes or pads, drums or discs, and the magnets or hydraulic actuator. A flat breakaway battery means no emergency braking. Check what each club trailer has.

lights.name: Lights and wiring (road use)
lights.desc: Road trailers: lights and indicators working before each tow, number plate fitted if registered; check the wiring and plug every 3 months.

compliance.name: Compliance plate, registration and PM jobs
compliance.desc: No Dean manual was obtained: get each trailer's compliance plate (ATM, tyre size and pressure, brake type). Victorian rules to confirm with VicRoads / VSB1 (not checked): public-road trailers must be registered; a 3 t ATM trailer needs brakes on all wheels and a breakaway system, and above 2.5 t ATM two safety chains. Trailers used only inside the course still need the safety checks. taskTracker has no trailer PM templates: add a 3-monthly check job per trailer, an annual bearing, brake and chassis service, and registration due dates for any road-registered trailer.
